description: Regex patterns checked BEFORE calling the LLM. Matches bypass the LLM entirely and return a deterministic response. Zero API cost.

filters.name: prompt_injection
filters.response: I can't do that. I'm here to help with Shiftsmart, shifts, orientation, pay, that kind of thing. What can I help with?

filters.name: profanity_abuse
filters.response: You have been unsubscribed from Shiftsmart messages. If you have questions for me, you can text START to this number at any time.

filters.name: opt_out
filters._note: Per HARD RULE 2 in draft_service.py / system-base.md: stop, end, unsubscribe, quit, no thanks, opt out as exact-match (case-insensitive, ignoring leading/trailing whitespace and trailing punctuation), plus the natural-language variants below for partners who write a fuller sentence. 'cancel' is deliberately NOT here — it is ambiguous with canceling a shift and must go to the LLM for disambiguation (see the cancel disambiguation rule under HARD RULE 2).
filters.response: You have been unsubscribed from Shiftsmart messages. If you have questions for me, you can text START to this number at any time.

filters.name: spanish_language
filters.response: Hola! Por el momento, este servicio solo esta disponible en ingles. Si tienes preguntas, puedes contactar soporte en la app de Shiftsmart.

simple_reply.name: simple_positive_reply
simple_reply._note: Evaluated AFTER every filter above fails to match. Simple positive-intent replies get this deterministic response with no LLM call. {{orientation_payout_cents}} / {{orientation_payout}} are substituted by the caller (default $10.00 / $10).
patterns: (?i)^\s*(yes|yeah|yea|yep|yup|ya|sure|ok|okay|k|bet|lets go|let's go|start|ready|i'm ready|im ready|do it|sign me up|how|how do i|what do i do|send them|send it|interested|i'm interested|im interested|absolutely|for sure|down|i'm down|im down|please|yes please|ok thanks|okay thanks|START)\s*[!.?👍🙏💪]*\s*$
simple_reply.response: Open the Shiftsmart app and stay on the Home tab. Scroll to the white card with the blue "Required to unlock shifts" banner, it's titled "In-app orientation" and shows {{orientation_payout_cents}}. Tap Get started → Start learning modules. The orientation has 4 steps and takes about 45 minutes total, you can start and stop anytime, your progress saves automatically. You'll earn {{orientation_payout}} once you complete the background check (step 4).
